W10-G02.title: The 13–1 season that ended in the semifinal
W10-G02.public_copy: In the 2022 Week 16 semifinal, El Niño beat Red Leopards 116.32–97.96 by 18.36. Red had finished the regular season 13–1 as the No.1 seed; El Niño entered 7–7 as the No.5 seed. Niño then won the championship.
W10-G02.supported_stakes: Verified semifinal elimination of the No.1 seed; El Niño went on to win the championship.
W10-G02.creative_use_scope: This supports a specific championship-run wound, rather than a generic regular-season playoff-push loss. Current Week10 can echo the history only conditionally until the final result locks.

incidents.classification: Serious injury reported; season-ending outcome NOT confirmed
incidents.fact: Maye left Sunday's Munich game with an ankle/lower-leg injury. Monday reporting describes an indefinite or extended absence, potentially the rest of the season, with further medical determination pending.
incidents.week11: New England is on bye; Duckhook needed a different quarterback for Week11 regardless. The injury threatens the plan from Week12 onward.
incidents.owned_option: C.J. Stroud is already owned on Duckhook's bench, tagged Active, and played Sunday in the official Houston box score. Treat him as the first internal candidate, subject to the Week11 report and Thursday lock.
incidents.forecast: Plan for a potentially prolonged QB change. Do not print 'Maye's season is over' or a guaranteed return week.
incidents.safe_copy: Duckhook's quarterback plan changed Sunday. Maye faces an extended absence; a season-ending outcome is still unconfirmed. With New England on bye, owned reserve C.J. Stroud becomes the immediate planning option.

incidents.classification: Confirmed game exit/concussion; Week11 final designation pending
incidents.fact: Houston ruled Marks out with a concussion Sunday. Ryans reportedly considers Thursday availability unlikely.
incidents.week11: Houston plays Thursday Nov19: this is the earliest injury decision, before most Sunday final reports. Concussion clearance is required; do not infer season-ending loss.
incidents.owned_option: No injured teammate is an automatic handcuff. Saquon Barkley and Kenny Gainwell are rostered alternatives to assess, but this pass has not established their Week11 medical clearance; no unconditional replacement recommendation.
incidents.forecast: Show a short decision window, not an invented recovery deadline. The team still has a playoff route per the league audit, so injury and Cancun metaphor must not become elimination fact.
incidents.safe_copy: The Mud Dogs' next problem arrives Thursday: Woody Marks left with a concussion, and the short week puts his availability in doubt.

incidents.classification: Ankle injury; reportedly day-to-day, not season-ending
incidents.fact: Bowers exited Sunday with an ankle injury; Monday NFL Network reporting carried by Reuters says a major injury is not believed to have occurred, with further testing planned.
incidents.week11: Chili also loses Hunter Henry and Kyle Pitts to NFL byes, so healthy TE depth is narrower than the roster's four TE names imply.
incidents.owned_option: Michael Mayer is already on Chili's bench, currently Active, and his official log confirms Sunday participation. He is the owned contingency to evaluate if Bowers is unavailable; participation does not guarantee Week11 health or equivalent output.
incidents.forecast: Await tests/practice; preserve a Bowers-plays branch. Do not bury him in a season-ending casualty headline.
incidents.safe_copy: Bowers is reportedly day-to-day after his ankle injury. With Henry and Pitts on bye, Chili's own reserve Michael Mayer becomes the first contingency if Bowers cannot go.

incidents.classification: Confirmed hamstring exit; recovery duration unresolved
incidents.fact: Brown's return from prior knee trouble ended with a hamstring injury in Sunday's game.
incidents.week11: Patriots bye removes Brown regardless of injury; Week12 outlook also depends on both Brown's recovery and New England's quarterback situation.
incidents.owned_option: No medically cleared Week11 replacement is asserted here. TDS owns several WR options, but McConkey is currently out, Burden carries a provider Questionable flag, and the next practice cycle must be checked.
incidents.forecast: Do not translate commentary calling this a lost season into a medical season-ending declaration.
incidents.safe_copy: Brown's comeback ended with another injury. The bye buys time, but the Snake's receiving plan now waits on a hamstring update and a changing Patriots offense.

incidents.classification: Ankle injury reported; primary severity/Week11 status unresolved
incidents.fact: USA TODAY reports an ankle injury during Sunday's game. Fresh provider roster marks him Questionable.
incidents.week11: TDS already has three current starters on bye and Brown/McConkey/Burden issues; Robinson's availability is an additional roster vulnerability.
incidents.owned_option: Do not promote a replacement as healthy before checking the next official report.
incidents.forecast: Do not state season-ending, a medical grade, or an official Week11 game designation before it exists.
incidents.safe_copy: The Snake's receiver decisions keep multiplying: Robinson's ankle now joins the Week11 watch list.

incidents.classification: Concussion evaluation and non-return confirmed; diagnosis/clearance unresolved
incidents.fact: Atlanta says London was evaluated for a concussion late Sunday and did not return.
incidents.week11: Atlanta is on bye, as are Slob starters Fannin and Shaheed. Track London for Week12 without announcing a diagnosed concussion from the evaluation alone.

incidents.forecast: Slob's dominance in Week10 does not erase its Week11 TE vacancy and three current-starter byes.
incidents.safe_copy: Slob won the road this week; next week's lineup still needs rebuilding. London is under injury review, and three current starters are on bye.

incidents.classification: Confirmed new NFL IR placement; not confirmed season-ending

incidents.week11: Already unavailable in Slob's current roster; cannot be used as immediate bye relief.

incidents.safe_copy: Henderson's Saturday IR move further reduces Slob's available depth.

incidents.classification: Confirmed existing IR; prolonged recovery, no fixed return date
incidents.fact: Baltimore reports a broken/dislocated thumb and says surgical recovery for this type of injury typically takes 6–10 weeks, with progress guiding return.

incidents.forecast: Useful support for Red's strain, but the injury predates this weekend and does not prove fantasy playoff elimination.
incidents.safe_copy: Red's storm was already gathering: Lamar remains on IR, with recovery rather than a calendar promise determining his return.

incidents.owned_option: No replacement claims are added without the next injury report; this is a roster-construction constraint.
incidents.forecast: Obi must bridge the remaining regular-season weeks without assuming a Puka return before Week15; eligibility is not medical clearance.
incidents.safe_copy: Obi's reinforcements have a calendar problem: Puka cannot return from IR before Week15.

incidents.week11: No assumption of availability against the Jets next Sunday. Recheck the next practice report.
incidents.forecast: He is benched in Schemin; do not subtract points from the current starting lineup. Relevant to depth, not a new starter loss.
incidents.safe_copy: McConkey will not play Monday. For TDS, that is another depth restriction entering a three-starter bye week.

incidents.fact: The Jets say Cooper sustained an ankle injury and was due further testing Monday.
incidents.week11: Do not treat him as settled cover for Slob's London/Shaheed byes.
incidents.forecast: Jets QB Geno Smith's ankle status also affects the passing ecosystem. Any role/efficiency change is an inference, not a guarantee.
incidents.safe_copy: Slob's reserve receiver Cooper is awaiting ankle clarity, so the bye-week replacement list remains fluid.

incidents.fact: Tennessee's coach expressed hope for a Week11 return and said Wednesday would provide a clearer answer.
incidents.week11: Potential help for HMB's JSN/Mumpfield bye holes, but not an established starter or cleared replacement.
